config.execution: decide at close of bar d -> fill at open of bar d+1 -> hold to the next fill
config.cash: cash leg earns 0 in the ledger (disclosed, not modelled away)

note: card_open_to_open charges the fill at the open of the bar whose close produced the score (a one-bar lookahead) and therefore holds over a window shifted by exactly one bar; honest_next_open is what the forward ledger accrues. Turnover is identical on both, so this is a WINDOW ALIGNMENT difference, not two portfolios: the sign of the gap is not alpha and must not be read as one -- it says the headline is sensitive to which single bar the holding period starts on.
